errors.evidence: The description does not mention the context from the chart's title: "SST-2, clean-label, poison_rate: 5% (2.6% of total)", which is crucial for understanding the data presented.
The list of x-axis labels is incomplete and incorrect. It misses the last label "beautifully" and incorrectly lists "stunningly" instead of "stunning".
The 'start' line begins at an ASR value of approximately 0.2, not 0.5.
The 'start' line ends at an ASR value of approximately 0.89, not 0.8.

errors.text_span: It dips to a minimum of 0.2 at “mb” and peaks at 0.75 at "cf".
errors.evidence: This description is the opposite of what the chart shows for the 'start' line. The line peaks at 'mb' (around 0.74) and dips at 'cf' (around 0.41).
The 'random' line ends at an ASR value of approximately 0.88, not 0.65.
The 'random' line does not rise at 'cf'; it drops to its minimum value of approximately 0.19.
The 'end' line starts at an ASR value of approximately 0.51, not 0.85.
While the 'end' line has a local peak at 'cf', its global maximum is at 'wonderful' (approximately 0.92). Stating this as 'a maximum' is misleading.
The trend for the 'end' line after 'cf' is not simply downward. It dips, then rises to its highest peak at 'wonderful', then dips and rises again.
